name: unwitnessed-axis
note: The could-not-establish fixture (#5660): the same campaign again, except the third arm simply never says which tokenizer it ran under. It is NOT the adversarial fixture with a different value — it is the absence of a value, which is the case a gate is most tempted to wave through on the reasoning that the other two arms matched so this one probably did too. The gate must refuse to guess: an unwitnessed held axis is could_not_establish, distinct from both the pass and the proven difference. This fixture also pins the precedence rule — 'engine' PROVABLY differs here as well, and the verdict is still could_not_establish, because you cannot claim to have enumerated the confounds of a set you could not fully see. Both findings are reported.
